name: B10-0568/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the immediate return of constitutional and democratic order in Guinea-Bissau after the military seized power on 26 November 2025, the day before election results were due. It demands new elections without delay, the release of everyone detained for political, journalistic or civil society activity, and respect for basic freedoms. It also asks the European Union to stop any funding that could help the military leaders and to back democratic groups and independent media instead.

- The military must hand back power and elections must be held; the people of Guinea-Bissau are affected.
- The EU should cut funding that could help the military leaders and support democratic groups instead.
- The Parliament asks for an independent investigation into human rights abuses, with those responsible held accountable.
